# Kerygma Social

> One URL. Endless Content.

Kerygma Social is a social media automation platform for small businesses. Drop your website URL and Kerygma Social researches your brand, generates posts for approval, and publishes to LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook.

## What Kerygma Social does

- Crawls your website to learn your brand, industry, and topics
- Generates a balanced mix of SEO, GEO (AI-discoverability), and money (conversion) posts
- Lets you refine captions and images in plain language before publishing
- Connects to LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook (more channels coming soon)

## AI assistants (remote MCP)

Run Kerygma Social from Claude or ChatGPT by adding one MCP address:

- MCP URL: https://kerygmasocial.com/api/mcp
- Auth: Authorization: Bearer ks_live_… (create a key in app Settings)
- Tools: list_brands, get_brand, generate_posts, list_pending_posts, approve_post, reschedule_post, get_calendar
- Flow: read brand voice → generate drafts → approve to schedule → calendar. Publishing still needs social accounts connected in the app.

Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → paste the MCP URL → Bearer API key.
ChatGPT: add a remote MCP / custom connector with the same URL and Bearer key when available.
